snippet.title: Perplexicube - Official Demo Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the demo now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4581340/Perplexicube/

Perplexicube is a challenging isometric puzzler where you must work together with your past and future selves. You'll have to think ahead as you create loops backwards in time to set your futures selves up for success.
